svg.text: Install once, build the payload once per person, then paste job descriptions.
Registers this repo as a marketplace
Pulls both skills and the LaTeX templates
PDF compiler, plus the tools that read the PDF back
Hand over your current CV (PDF, DOCX or text)
Facts copied as written; old bullet prose is dropped
What each number measured, baseline to result, how, whose work
Describe a project the way you would to a friend; that register is kept
Lanes, page length, skip list, work authorisation, salary bands
The settings the pipeline reads before it writes anything
A six-line CV compiles and your name reads back from the PDF
Wrong country, skipped company, unclear “Remote”: stops, nothing written
Fit 0–100 against your facts, must-hit keywords, gaps with honest mitigations
What they need, what they fear, what 200 other CVs say, one hook, keyword map
You answer “Go?”, the only decision in the pipeline
Writes from the brief and the payload only; never re-reads the JD
Assemble, compile, check page count, grep every keyword in the PDF text
Word and pattern blacklist: no leverage, rule of three, participle tails, em-dashes
ATS coverage, 6-second read, slop, JD echo, length. Ship at 90% and 8/10
one row per CV; feeds the next brief
Salary from your bands, visa from your standard answer, DMs under 80 words
Up to 10 JDs, Analyzer only, ranked table, you pick
New role, new cert, corrected number: written back with a date
Ten JDs per session. Then open a new one; the log and the PDFs stay on disk.
